title: Synthesis of isoluminol derivatives with a terminal carboxyl group for protein labelling
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17776-17780
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00677E, Paper
Open Access

Qiao Ma, Lei Liu, Chunfeng Luo, Yue Wu, Fengshu Qin, Kai Du
We synthesized isoluminol derivatives with a terminal carboxyl group. The resulting NHS ester is a stable, efficient chemiluminescent reagent with high protein labelling efficacy.
